_comentario: Biblioteca FIJA de efectos de /video, generada UNA vez con el nodo sfx (eleven_text_to_sound_v2) e importada con scripts/sfx.py --importar. /video nunca genera efectos; para cambiar uno, reimportar la url de otra variación.

efectos.prompt: Short soft air whoosh, smooth and dry, close-mic, no tail
Single short dry wooden tick, like a soft pencil tap on a desk, no reverb
Single soft deep thump, muted kick-like, dry, quick decay
Short cinematic impact with a muted low boom and a subtle tight click, dry, fast decay
Deep low sub-bass drop hit with a slow dark tail, cinematic, no high frequencies
Two second tense filtered noise riser building steadily and cutting off cleanly at the end
Soft warm synth pad chord swelling gently and resolving, short, calm
Very subtle soft airy sweep, quiet, like a slow breath, short

efectos.uso: cada tanda de asientos del hemiciclo
efectos.prompt: Single tiny soft UI pop, like a bubble click on a touchscreen, very short, dry, no tail
Single wooden gavel strike on a sound block in a large hall, short natural tail
Single rubber stamp pressed firmly on paper on a wooden desk, dry thud, close-mic
Very fast short swish whip pan, airy, crisp, dry, no tail, subtle

efectos.uso: entrada de un documento o recorte
